latest_release.name: v0.1.13
latest_release.body:
## What changed

- Pin the MCP extra to mcp 2.1.1.
- Pin release build tooling to build 1.6.0 and setuptools 84.0.0.
- Preserve the Chrome permission and macOS accessibility reliability improvements from 0.1.12.

## Verification

- 251 unit tests passed with the MCP extra.
- pip-audit found no known vulnerabilities in the resolved environment.
- Wheel and source distribution built successfully.
